description: Project scaffold: uv project with cvgen entry point; ruff and pytest run
steps: uv run cvgen --help prints commands validate and build

description: JSON Schemas for content, profile, theme, locale and pii-fields files
steps: Open examples/content/cv.yaml in an editor with YAML language server
uv run cvgen validate --content examples/content exits 0

description: Synthetic example CV covering every section, with no real personal data
steps: uv run cvgen validate --content examples/content exits 0
grep finds no email or phone pattern in examples/

description: validate reports schema errors with file, line and rule
steps: Remove work[0].startDate in a copy of the example
Output names the file, line and missing property; exit code 1

description: PII guard rejects forbidden basics keys (name, email, phone, url, location, profiles, image)
steps: Run validate on each fixture in tests/fixtures/pii/forbidden-keys

description: PII guard rejects email, phone, CPR-like and personal profile URL patterns in any string
steps: Run validate on each fixture in tests/fixtures/pii/patterns
Each exits 1 naming file and line

description: Runtime prompt asks for the fields the profile requires and validates each answer
steps: Prompt repeats with the format rule

description: Non-interactive mode reads CVGEN_PII_* env vars and fails clearly if one is missing
PII values never appear in logs, tracebacks or files outside out/
steps: Run build with synthetic PII and --verbose
grep the console output and the repo (excluding out/) for each value: no hit

description: JSON Resume export validates against the official JSON Resume schema
steps: Validate out/*.json against the JSON Resume 1.0.0 schema: pass

description: schema.org JSON-LD export describes a Person with roles, credentials and skills
steps: Parse out/*.jsonld; @type is Person; hasOccupation/hasCredential present

description: sidebar theme renders HTML with sidebar and main regions from the profile
steps: Sidebar shows photo, contact, skills, languages; main shows summary, work, projects

description: PDF output built from the same HTML, A4, fonts embedded
steps: pdffonts shows embedded fonts; page size is A4

description: Profiles filter, order and limit projects and highlights
steps: Projects count <= profile max; order is newest first

description: Locales en and da change labels and date formats; localized content strings resolve with fallback
steps: Headings are Danish; dates show Danish month names

description: Computed values such as {years_experience} are filled from work dates
steps: Summary shows the number of years since the first work startDate

description: Markdown and plain-text (ATS) outputs
steps: out/*.md and out/*.txt contain every section heading and each entry's title and dates

description: PDF is tagged PDF/UA-1 and the HTML meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast
steps: Run veraPDF PDF/UA-1 profile on out/*.pdf: pass

description: Page budget: lowest-priority highlights are dropped until pageLimit fits
steps: PDF has <= 2 pages and the dropped highlights have the lowest x-priority

description: CI validates, tests and builds the synthetic example; fails on any tracked PII
steps: Push a commit adding an email to examples/: workflow fails
